report.summary: Chunk 10 of picker.py: implements attempt memory handling, rendering functions (_evidence_lines, render_queue, review_packet, _console_safe), and CLI helper (_default_attempt, _build_parser). Public symbols: render_queue, review_packet, _console_safe, _default_attempt. Checkable claims verified.
risks: review_packet | medium | The claim 'states in three places that nothing was applied' is uncheckable because the chunk does not contain enough context to count the places. The function does include 'NOTHING HAS BEEN APPLIED' and 'nothing has been run' but not three distinct statements. To settle: count explicit statements in the function.

_console_safe | low | The docstring claims 'Preserve the exact text when representable and escape only unsupported code points.' The implementation uses backslashreplace which escapes unsupported code points, so the claim is kept. However, the docstring also mentions 'Windows PowerShell may expose a CP-1252 stdout' which is uncheckable as it refers to external behavior.

review_packet | low | The docstring claims 'The patch bytes are decoded for display only.' The function uses artifact.diff (which is decoded) and artifact_path (for raw bytes). The claim is kept. However, the statement 'A human promoting this must write artifact_path (the raw bytes) -- a diff round-tripped through a terminal is not the artifact that was hashed and gated' is uncheckable because it refers to external behavior.

_default_attempt | medium | The docstring claims 'Split out as the single injection seam so --dry-run can be tested by passing an attempt_fn that raises: proving the flag does not attempt anything requires a way to observe an attempt that never happens.' The function does not accept an attempt_fn parameter; it always calls run_attempt. This is inconsistent with the docstring. To settle: check if the function signature is missing the parameter or if the docstring is outdated.

observations.what: The _default_attempt function docstring describes an injection seam (attempt_fn parameter) that is not present in the function signature.
The review_packet function includes a claim about stating 'nothing was applied' in three places, but the code shows only one explicit 'NOTHING HAS BEEN APPLIED' and one 'nothing has been run'.
The _console_safe docstring references Windows PowerShell CP-1252 behavior, which is uncheckable from this chunk.
The _build_parser function is a stub; only the import statement is shown, no parser construction.
